requests.prompt:
EDIT THE PROVIDED REFERENCE into a production 2D HD combat sprite sheet for a French Mass Effect 1 fan RPG. Reference: crew-atlas.png is 1536x1024 with 8 people. Select ONLY ASHLEY WILLIAMS, the human woman in the SECOND cell of the TOP row, pixel rectangle x384 y0 width384 height512. Do not depict any of the other seven characters. Preserve that Ashley identity: adult athletic realistic human woman, warm light/olive skin, brown eyes, dark brown hair in a compact low bun, no helmet, light off-white armor with dusty pink and dark burgundy-red inset plates, dark flexible undersuit, compact armored boots. This is the existing game's ME1 Ashley costume. Do not add Shepard's N7 lettering/stripes, ME3 blue suit, new emblems, sexualized anatomy, or biotic abilities.
Create ONE transparent RGBA landscape atlas, ideally 1536x1024, FOUR separate full-body key poses of the SAME Ashley, arranged as a generous separated 2x2 sheet. Top left: AIM — three-quarter facing right, stable feet, shouldered generic compact sci-fi assault rifle aimed toward right. Top right: POWER — same three-quarter body, one arm making a neutral military command/support gesture, weapon safely lowered in other hand; Ashley is a SOLDIER, not a biotic: absolutely no glow, magic, energy orb or force field. Bottom left: HIT — same armor and identity, recoiling backward from a non-graphic impact, knees flexed, entire body and both boots visible. Bottom right: DOWN — the same fully armored body lying horizontally on its side, head to the left and boots to the right, harmless knocked-out pose, no injury or blood. Use at least 30px transparent outer padding around each figure and clear empty gutters between figures; no overlapping cells, crop, split heads, detached limbs or cut-off gun. Standing poses consistent anatomical scale, realistic adult proportions and coherent armor panels. Down pose has the same anatomical size and is not a tiny icon. Camera stays fixed orthographic three-quarter, soft top-left diffuse studio light, detailed pre-rendered JRPG sprite art matching the reference's material rendering, clear clean silhouette and edge treatment. Isolated figures on TRUE transparent background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no floor/shadow plate, vignette, backdrop, text, pose labels, frame borders, UI, signatures, watermark or embedded VFX. This sheet is four fixed prototype poses, not a complete animation. Return the generated PNG unchanged for direct game integration.
